purpose: Cell (a) of the three Earnings-22 model-usage alignment cells: ONE factor, the decoder quantization, on 1,500 rows of this study's own Earnings-22 DEV subset10, paired row for row against the SEALED comparator on identical audio bytes. Nothing about the request changes -- same instruction, same shape, same decoding params, same geometry, same build, same audio path, same audio encoder by sha256. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-dev-usage-cells-v1-preregistration.md section 1. NOT AUTHORIZED by this fragment: the cell needs its own owner GO, its own exposure row registered before the first contact, and its own contracts.ExecutionPlan.

E22-ESB-DEV1500-UTTERANCES.selection: 150 per source call at seed 20260906 through core.roster.freeze_roster, by the model-free row SAEA-SN-MF-E22-DEV1500-ROSTER-V1
E22-ESB-DEV1500-UTTERANCES.why_a_subset_and_not_all_6038: the Q8_0 cell costs about 7.9x the per-call latency of the resident Q4_K_M core, so a 6,038-row pass is hours of GPU where a 1,500-row pass is not. 1,500 is far above the owner's n >= 400 paired-claim floor of 2026-09-03 and keeps every one of the ten call strata at 150, which is what makes the call-stratified bootstrap well-posed.
E22-ESB-DEV1500-UTTERANCES.estimand: the paired within-utterance effect of the decoder quantization on corpus WER and on the agentic error rate, on a population this study is allowed to optimize on

Same roster, same media bytes, same instruction, same reference layer, same scorers, same build, same encoder, same geometry, same decoding params, same harness, same entry point, same prompt shape.

deviations.deviation: --n-cpu-moe 28: the Mixture-of-Experts tensors of the first 28 of 48 layers sit in host RAM
deviations.why: 30.3 GiB of Q8_0 weights cannot be resident on a 24,463 MiB card. N is FORCED by the file, not chosen for convenience, and 28 is re-derived on THIS geometry rather than copied from the A2T probe's 24 -- which left 2,228 MiB free against a 2,940 MiB encoder estimate that probe never exercised, because every one of its 400 rows was a feature-cache hit.
deviations.expected_effect: latency, not transcripts: attention, norms, embeddings and 20 layers of experts stay on the GPU and every weight is bit-identical wherever it sits

deviations.deviation: CPU and CUDA kernels accumulate in different orders, so a rare greedy tie can flip
deviations.why: a consequence of D-Q8-1, recorded rather than tuned away; it was a caveat of the A2T probe and it stays one
deviations.expected_effect: unknown in sign and small in size; it cuts AGAINST over-reading a small effect, not for it

deviations.deviation: the experiment fragment carries ONE cell, not the three the preregistration's section 6 imagined in one file
deviations.why: a composed experiment fragment declares exactly one execution_plan object (core.flight.FlightRuntime._build_execution_plan reads values['execution_plan']) and that object carries the single execution_profile contracts.assert_execution_scope validates. This cell plans 2.0 GPU-hours and cell (b) 0.20, so the two cannot share one plan.
deviations.expected_effect: none on any request byte; it is a packaging fact

deviations.deviation: transport timeout_seconds 900 rather than the comparator's 420
deviations.why: the Q8_0 decoder at N = 28 is roughly 7.85x the resident Q4_K_M per-call latency and every row pays a live mmproj encode; a transport timeout firing mid-flight would cost the attempt
deviations.expected_effect: none on any transcript: it is a client-side deadline, not a request field

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 1,500 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 1,508; the registered exposure ceiling is 1,600.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 9,948.983 s for one pass, rounded up to 10,000; the registered ceiling is 10,500.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 2.0 planned, 3.0 registered, derived rather than guessed. Two rates exist and they disagree, so both are named and the larger is used: the August whole-model-offload note measured 4.17x the resident Q4_K_M rate, and the 2026-09-05 A2T Q8 flight measured 7.85x in steady state over 400 calls (6.141 s mean latency against 0.782 s) and explained the difference -- the smoke's 32x figure was a cold page cache faulting 14 GiB of CPU-resident expert tensors in from ext4. The sealed comparator ran at 1.927 s mean latency and 3.744 contacts/s at eight slots, so 7.85x gives about 15.1 s per call and roughly 2,830 s of dispatch for 1,500 rows. Two additions push the plan above that arithmetic and both are real: N = 28 puts four more layers on the CPU than the measured 7.85x was measured at, and every row here pays a live mmproj encode the A2T probe never paid. The A2T flight's own per-audio-second rate (about 0.29 GPU-h for 2,159.7 s) scaled to 9,949 s is 1.34 h; 2.0 planned and 3.0 registered is that with room.
execution_plan_basis.cumulative_metering: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure row's own calls / speech-audio-seconds / gpu-hours cells, and the plan budget is metered CUMULATIVELY across every attempt of this run id, so a recovery plan must cover prior durable spend as well as its own worst case.

decision.rule: ADMITTED as a model-usage local optimization iff BOTH hold: (1) corpus WER improves and the CI90 upper bound on the delta is below 0; and (2) the agentic error rate does not worsen -- the CI90 upper bound on its delta is below +0.05 points.
decision.non_inferiority_margin_provenance: +0.05 points, inherited verbatim from section 1.6 of docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-dev-boundary-exact-v1-preregistration.md and fixed before any number exists.
decision.cost_disclosure: Even if ADMITTED, this cell's setting costs about 7.9x the per-call latency. Whether that is worth paying is an owner decision this fragment does not make and the verdict must state the ratio it measured.
decision.claim_surface: A dev number on a 1,500-row subset of this study's own dev split. This is NOT an alignment verdict, it is not compared to the published 9.79 or 12.3 as a difference, and the published figures appear as orientation only where they appear at all.
decision.test_read: NONE. This is not a scorer-side change -- Q8_0 changes the decoder -- so applying it to the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls would require RE-FLYING them, a second read of a population the 2026-09-04 owner allowance permitted once. It may be proposed to the owner and never taken on this fragment's authority.
decision.not_authorized: No mechanism arm. No knob tuned on the test split. No fourth prompt. No few-shot. No post-processing of any hypothesis. No re-scoring of any sealed arm. No merge_compounds. No packet or feature-cache path. No stop string. No second read of the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls. No read of any confirmatory call. No paper-scale-confirmatory profile, no manuscript, no submission, no Stage-3 activity.

companion_run.why_separate: contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, and the smoke's four rows have a different split identity hash and a much smaller budget, so it cannot share a run id with the flight.
